g.text: Gold-input ablation. 'full' = sentiment on the ASR transcript, 'norm' = the same text lowercased without punctuation, 'gold' = human SLUE transcript. Format

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: changes almost nothing; human text adds at most 0.034 macro-F1 for Cardiff.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #898781

g.text: Macro-F1 = the plain average of the F1 score for each of the three sentiment classes (negative, neutral, positive), so the rare negative class counts as much as the common neutral one.
